conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { const body = $json.body; if (body.action !== 'review_requested') return false; if (body.sender && body.sender.type === 'Bot') return false; const botLogins = ($env.N8N_BOT_LOGINS || '').split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean); if (botLogins.includes(body.sender && body.sender.login)) return false; const reviewer = body.requested_reviewer && body.requested_reviewer.login; if (!reviewer) return false; let map = {}; try { map = JSON.parse($env.N8N_AGENT_MAP || '{}'); } catch (e) { return false; } return !!(map[reviewer] && map[reviewer].role === 'reviewer'); })() }}

parameters.command:
=set +e
set -o pipefail
PR={{ $json.prNumber }}
BASE="{{ $json.prBaseRef }}"
SHA="{{ $json.prHeadSha }}"
cd ~/workspace || exit 10
_URL=$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null)
_T="${_URL#*x-access-token:}"
export GH_TOKEN="${_T%%@*}"
git fetch origin "pull/$PR/head:pr-$PR" 2>&1
git fetch origin "$BASE" 2>&1
git checkout "pr-$PR" 2>&1
PROMPT="/tmp/review-$PR.txt"
echo {{ $json.promptB64 }} | base64 -d > "$PROMPT"
echo "" >> "$PROMPT"
echo "=== DIFF ===" >> "$PROMPT"
git diff "origin/$BASE...HEAD" >> "$PROMPT"
REVIEW=$(claude --print < "$PROMPT")
CLAUDE_RC=$?
rm -f "$PROMPT"
echo "CLAUDE_RC=$CLAUDE_RC"
if [ -z "$REVIEW" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: empty review from claude" >&2
  exit 0
fi
BODY="/tmp/review-body-$PR.md"
printf '%s\n' "$REVIEW" > "$BODY"
gh pr review "$PR" --comment --body-file "$BODY" 2>&1
REVIEW_RC=$?
rm -f "$BODY"
echo "REVIEW_RC=$REVIEW_RC"
exit 0
